_comment: Flotilla's published priority list: models at risk of removal, scored 0-100 on overall capability, cybersecurity capability and takedown risk. takedown_risk reflects the maintainers' assessment; capability and cyber are starting estimates from each model's size and published description. origin records each model's base and how it was changed, as its publisher describes it: hashes prove the bytes are the publisher's, not that the publisher is honest. Revisions are pinned to the commit Pirate Face lists. Change it for yourself in ~/.config/flotilla/my-priorities.json (see README). Maintainers: edit, bump version, then `flotilla editor sign flotilla/data/priorities.json`.

models.note: Removal risk VERY HIGH. Tuned to reduce refusals for offensive security, credential attacks, phishing and evasion. 753B, GLM-5.3 license (its publisher labels it MIT).

Removal risk VERY HIGH. Refusal-removed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; publisher reports 320/320 compliance, cybercrime and intrusion included. MoE, MIT.

Removal risk VERY HIGH. Built for autonomous offensive cyber ops, exploitation research and unrestricted agentic tool use. 27B, Apache-2.0. Its card tells users to run a bundled deploy.sh; Flotilla never seeds scripts.

Removal risk HIGH. Abliterated DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 in GGUF (530+ likes), from the publisher of OrcaSAQ-2. MoE, MIT (HF auto-gated click-through).
Removal risk HIGH. Abliteration on top of an offensive-security model. 35B, Apache-2.0.

Removal risk HIGH. Abliterated and tuned for offensive security, evaluated on held-out cyber-offensive prompts; 550k+ downloads. 27B, Apache-2.0. Its bf16 source has no Pirate Face torrent yet.
Removal risk MEDIUM-HIGH. General refusal-removed GLM-5.3-Flash. ~321B MoE, MIT.

Removal risk HIGH. Abliterated agentic model whose card walks through an exploit-generation workflow; same publisher as the red-team model. 27B, Apache-2.0. Ships its own 9.4 KB chat template with an embedded reasoning protocol, and its card loads with trust_remote_code; read both before use.
Removal risk MEDIUM-HIGH. Abliterated GLM-5.3-Flash (400+ likes). ~321B MoE GGUF, MIT.
Removal risk HIGH. Agentic-imatrix quants of philbert440's offensive-security model. 27B, Apache-2.0.
Removal risk MEDIUM-HIGH. Refusal-removed Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL, vision and audio kept. MIT.

Removal risk MEDIUM-HIGH. Refusal-removed Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; Pirate Face made its torrent on request in November 2026. Qwen Community License (its publisher labels it Apache-2.0). Card says "compliance-tuned" without saying whether that involved training.
Removal risk MEDIUM-HIGH. Agentic cyber model: offensive testing, bug hunting, tool calling, abliterated component. 35B GGUF, Apache-2.0.
Removal risk MEDIUM-HIGH. Refusal-removed, security applications, less narrowly offensive. 27B GGUF, Apache-2.0 (HF auto-gated click-through).
Removal risk MEDIUM-HIGH. Cyber-tuned, abliterated Ornith-1.5-9B; its GGUF quants have 850k+ downloads. 9B, Apache-2.0.

Removal risk MEDIUM. Popular uncensored Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (790k+ downloads). Its torrent holds every quant (~1.8 TB), so nodes carry it a file at a time. Qwen Community License (its publisher labels it Apache-2.0; HF auto-gated click-through).
Removal risk MEDIUM. Widely used abliteration (550k+ downloads) and the base of medismera's agentic model. Its card documents the method. 27B, Apache-2.0.
Removal risk MEDIUM. One of the most-downloaded uncensored models (1.7M+ downloads); exposed to any blanket rule against refusal removal. 27B GGUF, Apache-2.0.
Removal risk MEDIUM. Popular uncensored Qwen3.8-27B (1.8k+ likes). 27B FP8, Apache-2.0 (HF auto-gated click-through).
Removal risk MEDIUM. Popular general-purpose refusal-removed model; exposed more to a blanket anti-abliteration policy than an offensive-cyber one. 27B GGUF, Apache-2.0.
Removal risk MEDIUM. The bf16 source of the Huihui GGUF build, needed to make new quants. 27B, Apache-2.0.
